item.title: VMware ESXi OpenSLP Use-After-Free (CVE-2020-3992)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — network · CVE-2020-3992. Status: PoC (heap-grooming trigger for the vulnerable TCP/427 message path; crash/DoS demonstrated, full RCE chain not included). Affects: VMware ESXi, OpenSLP service (slpd), and VMware Cloud Foundation. Tags: VMware ESXi, OpenSLP, SLP, use-after-free, port 427, heap grooming, unauthenticated, CWE-416, CISA KEV.
